# openwebui_web_search_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's web search settings: the web search toggles, the search engine and its provider credentials, and the web page loader. These are the nested `web` settings of the retrieval config endpoint; the document retrieval (RAG) settings of the same endpoint are managed by `openwebui_retrieval_config` and are never sent by this resource.

~> Open WebUI replaces the whole web search configuration on every update. This resource therefore reads the current settings, changes only the attributes set in your configuration, and sends everything else back exactly as read. Any attribute you leave out keeps its current Open WebUI value, and its state shows that value. Removing an attribute from your configuration therefore does not reset it; set it to the value you want instead (`""` for strings, `[]` for lists, `{}` for JSON objects). The read and the write are separate requests: the provider keeps its own updates (including those of `openwebui_retrieval_config`) from running in between, but a web search change made by someone else in between is overwritten.

~> The API keys, passwords, `playwright_ws_url` and `youtube_loader_proxy_url` are stored in Terraform state because Open WebUI returns them in plain text. Protect your state accordingly. Of the URL attributes, only `playwright_ws_url` and `youtube_loader_proxy_url` are marked sensitive; the others (such as `searxng_query_url`, `external_web_search_url` and `external_web_loader_url`) are shown in plain text in plans and outputs, so do not embed credentials in them; use the matching `*_api_key` attributes instead.

~> If Open WebUI reports a different value during an apply for an attribute you do not set (because it was changed outside Terraform after the last refresh, or by Open WebUI during this apply), the apply leaves it unchanged and keeps the previous state value with a warning; the next refresh shows the server value.

~> Every update also makes Open WebUI re-save its retrieval settings and, while hybrid search is enabled, reload the reranking model inside the update request (see `openwebui_retrieval_config`). If that reload fails, Open WebUI turns hybrid search off (`enable_rag_hybrid_search`, managed by `openwebui_retrieval_config`), and the apply warns about it. The update request waits up to 10 minutes for Open WebUI to load the reranking model (unless a proxy in front of Open WebUI has a shorter timeout). If a download takes longer, the apply fails, but Open WebUI still completes the change, so re-running `terraform plan`/`terraform apply` converges. Open WebUI handles no other request while it loads a model, so other Open WebUI resources in the same apply (whose requests keep the provider's 30-second timeout) can time out meanwhile; re-running converges as well. Pre-downloading the model (for example by selecting it once in the Open WebUI admin page) avoids the wait.

-> An apply that changes nothing (no attribute configured, or every configured value equal to the current one) sends nothing. `YOUTUBE_LOADER_TRANSLATION` is not managed: Open WebUI keeps it in memory only and does not use it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only the attributes you set are changed; every other web search setting,
# including provider API keys you do not set here, keeps its current
# Open WebUI value.
resource "openwebui_web_search_config" "example" {
  enable_web_search       = true
  web_search_engine       = "searxng"
  searxng_query_url       = "http://searxng:8080/search?q=<query>"
  web_search_result_count = 3

  # Entries starting with "!" block a domain; [] means no filter.
  web_search_domain_filter_list = ["wikipedia.org", "!example.com"]

  web_loader_engine                  = "safe_web"
  enable_web_loader_ssl_verification = true
  youtube_loader_language            = ["en"]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `bing_search_v7_endpoint` (String) Bing Search v7 endpoint. Server default: `https://api.bing.microsoft.com/v7.0/search`.
- `bing_search_v7_subscription_key` (String, Sensitive) Bing Search v7 subscription key.
- `bocha_search_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Bocha Search API key.
- `brave_search_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Brave Search API key (`brave` and `brave_llm_context` engines).
- `brave_search_context_tokens` (Number) Maximum number of tokens the `brave_llm_context` engine retrieves (the Open WebUI admin UI offers 1024 to 32768). Server default: `8192`.
- `bypass_web_search_embedding_and_retrieval` (Boolean) Whether loaded web search results are passed to the model directly instead of being embedded and retrieved. Server default: `false`.
- `bypass_web_search_web_loader` (Boolean) Whether the search result snippets are used as they are instead of loading the result pages. Server default: `false`.
- `ddgs_backend` (String) Backend of the `duckduckgo` (DDGS) engine. Server default: `auto`.
- `enable_web_loader_ssl_verification` (Boolean) Whether the web loader verifies TLS certificates. Server default: `true`.
- `enable_web_search` (Boolean) Whether web search is enabled. Server default: `false`.
- `enable_web_search_confirmation` (Boolean) Whether users must confirm before a query is sent to the web search provider. Server default: `false`. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `exa_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Exa API key.
- `external_web_loader_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key of the external web loader.
- `external_web_loader_url` (String) URL of the external web loader (`external` loader).
- `external_web_search_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key of the external web search service.
- `external_web_search_url` (String) URL of the external web search service (`external` engine).
- `firecrawl_api_base_url` (String) Firecrawl API base URL. Server default: `https://api.firecrawl.dev`.
- `firecrawl_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Firecrawl API key (search engine and web loader).
- `firecrawl_timeout` (String) Firecrawl web loader timeout in whole seconds, as a string; `""` means the default. Must be empty or a plain whole number such as `30` (no sign, fraction, exponent or unit; Open WebUI silently ignores anything it cannot convert). Server default: `""`.
- `google_pse_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Google Programmable Search Engine API key.
- `google_pse_engine_id` (String) Google Programmable Search Engine ID.
- `jina_api_base_url` (String) Jina search API base URL. Empty means the hosted service.
- `jina_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Jina API key.
- `kagi_search_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Kagi Search API key.
- `linkup_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Linkup API key.
- `linkup_search_params_json` (String) JSON object of extra Linkup search parameters, for example `jsonencode({ depth = "deep" })`. Server default: `{}`. Compared semantically: key order and whitespace differences are not drift. Use `{}` for none (Open WebUI cannot store null here once set). Number literals must survive Open WebUI's Python JSON round trip: integers are exact (up to Python's 4300-digit limit), but a fraction or exponent that a 64-bit float cannot hold exactly (for example `9007199254740993.0`) or that overflows it (`1e400`) is rejected at plan time.
- `microsoft_web_iq_api_base_url` (String) Microsoft Web IQ API base URL (search engine and web loader). Server default: `https://api.microsoft.ai/v3`. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `microsoft_web_iq_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Microsoft Web IQ API key. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `microsoft_web_iq_language` (String) Microsoft Web IQ language. Server default: `en`. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `mojeek_search_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Mojeek Search API key.
- `ollama_cloud_web_search_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Ollama Cloud API key (`ollama_cloud` engine).
- `openserp_base_url` (String) OpenSERP base URL (`openserp` engine). Server default: `http://localhost:7000`. Added in Open WebUI v0.11.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `perplexity_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Perplexity API key (`perplexity` and `perplexity_search` engines).
- `perplexity_model` (String) Perplexity model (`perplexity` engine). Server default: `sonar`.
- `perplexity_search_api_url` (String) Perplexity Search API URL (`perplexity_search` engine). Server default: `https://api.perplexity.ai/search`.
- `perplexity_search_context_usage` (String) Perplexity search context size: `low`, `medium` or `high`. Server default: `medium`.
- `playwright_timeout` (Number) Playwright page load timeout in milliseconds. Server default: `10000`.
- `playwright_ws_url` (String, Sensitive) WebSocket URL of a remote Playwright browser; empty launches a local one. Sensitive because hosted browsers (such as browserless) take an access token in this URL.
- `searchapi_api_key` (String, Sensitive) SearchApi API key.
- `searchapi_engine` (String) SearchApi engine, for example `google`. Empty means the SearchApi default.
- `searxng_language` (String) SearXNG search language. Server default: `all`.
- `searxng_query_url` (String) SearXNG query URL, for example `http://searxng:8080/search?q=<query>`.
- `serpapi_api_key` (String, Sensitive) SerpApi API key.
- `serpapi_engine` (String) SerpApi engine, for example `google`. Empty means the SerpApi default.
- `serper_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Serper API key.
- `serphouse_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Serphouse API key. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `serphouse_domain` (String) Search engine domain Serphouse queries. Server default: `google.com`. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `serply_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Serply API key.
- `serpstack_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Serpstack API key.
- `serpstack_https` (Boolean) Whether Serpstack is called over HTTPS. Server default: `true`.
- `sougou_api_sid` (String, Sensitive) Sougou (Tencent Cloud) SecretId.
- `sougou_api_sk` (String, Sensitive) Sougou (Tencent Cloud) SecretKey.
- `tavily_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Tavily API key, used by the `tavily` search engine and the `tavily` web loader.
- `tavily_extract_depth` (String) Tavily web loader extract depth: `basic` or `advanced`. Server default: `basic`.
- `web_fetch_max_content_length` (Number) Maximum number of characters the built-in `fetch_url` tool returns; longer pages are truncated. Null (the server default) and `0` both mean no limit; once set, use `0` to remove the limit. Must be at least `0`.
- `web_loader_concurrent_requests` (Number) Rate limit of the built-in web loader in requests per second; `0` disables the limit. Must be at least `0`. Server default: `10`.
- `web_loader_engine` (String) Web page loader: `""` or `safe_web` (built-in), `playwright`, `firecrawl`, `tavily`, `external` or `microsoft_web_iq`. Open WebUI does not validate the value when saving, but every page load fails with any other value. Server default: `""`.
- `web_loader_timeout` (String) Timeout of the built-in and `microsoft_web_iq` loaders in seconds, as a string; `""` means the default. Must be empty or a plain decimal number such as `10` or `2.5` (no sign, exponent or unit; Open WebUI silently ignores anything it cannot convert). Server default: `""`.
- `web_search_concurrent_requests` (Number) Maximum number of search queries run in parallel; `0` means unlimited. Must be at least `0` (Open WebUI fails every search with a negative value). Server default: `0`.
- `web_search_confirmation_content` (String) Text of the confirmation prompt shown when `enable_web_search_confirmation` is on. Server default: `Your query will be sent to the configured web search provider.` Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `web_search_domain_filter_list` (List of String) Domains search results are restricted to; an entry starting with `!` blocks that domain instead. `[]` means no filter. Server default: `[]`.
- `web_search_engine` (String) Web search engine: one of `searxng`, `yacy`, `google_pse`, `brave`, `brave_llm_context`, `kagi`, `mojeek`, `bocha`, `serpstack`, `serper`, `serphouse`, `serply`, `duckduckgo`, `tavily`, `searchapi`, `serpapi`, `jina`, `bing`, `exa`, `perplexity`, `perplexity_search`, `microsoft_web_iq`, `sougou`, `firecrawl`, `external`, `yandex`, `youcom`, `linkup`, `ollama_cloud` or `openserp` (Open WebUI v0.11.0; older releases support fewer). `azure` exists too, but its settings are environment variables only. Open WebUI does not validate the value. Server default: `""`.
- `web_search_result_count` (Number) Number of search results used per query. Server default: `3`.
- `web_search_trust_env` (Boolean) Whether web search and web loader requests honour the proxy environment variables (`http_proxy`, `https_proxy`, ...). Server default: `true`.
- `yacy_password` (String, Sensitive) YaCy password.
- `yacy_query_url` (String) YaCy query URL.
- `yacy_username` (String) YaCy username.
- `yandex_web_search_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Yandex Search API key.
- `yandex_web_search_config` (String) Yandex search request template as JSON object text, used as the base of every request body; `""` means none. Stored verbatim as a string, so it is compared exactly. Must be empty or a JSON object.
- `yandex_web_search_url` (String) Yandex Search API URL. Empty means the public endpoint.
- `youcom_api_key` (String, Sensitive) You.com API key.
- `youtube_loader_language` (List of String) Preferred YouTube transcript languages, in order. Open WebUI stores null here when another client saves the web search settings without it; this resource leaves such a null untouched unless you set the attribute. Server default: `["en"]`.
- `youtube_loader_proxy_url` (String, Sensitive) Proxy URL for YouTube transcript requests. Sensitive because proxy URLs commonly embed credentials.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier, always `web_search`.
